description: This file implements a scheduler result logger for a wireless communication system, including detailed logging functions for various scheduling result components such as DCI logs, PDCCH, PDSCH, RAR, and UCI messages, with methods for debug and info level logging.

classes.name: scheduler_result_logger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging scheduling results, with methods for debug and info level logging, and handling whether broadcast or unicast results are logged.

methods.name: log_debug
methods.description: Logs detailed debug information about a scheduling result, including components like PDCCH, PDSCH, RAR, UCI, and others.

methods.name: log_info
methods.description: Logs summarized information about a scheduling result at info level.

methods.name: on_scheduler_result
methods.description: Main entry point to log a scheduling result, choosing between debug and info logging based on logger configuration.
